label: Shape Intelligence — Evidence Assembly
goal: Build bounded, provenance-complete evidence views for Shape intelligence.
purpose: Assemble the smallest useful normalized evidence packet without deciding the Shape or ranking semantic truth.
success_condition: Agents receive injection-safe bounded packets with exact source references, context windows, and explicit budget receipts.
objectives: Define evidence-packet schema and budget contract.
Preserve segment provenance and context windows.
Protect instructions from untrusted source content.
Make packet construction repeatable and auditable.
